about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cream Mousse Cups
recipes.summary: Silky dark chocolate mousse made with whipped cream and no raw egg.
steps: Melt the chocolate gently over a pan of barely simmering water, stir until smooth and cool for 10 minutes.
Whip 250ml of the cream with the sugar, vanilla and salt to soft peaks.
Stir a spoonful of the whipped cream into the chocolate to loosen it, then fold in the rest gently until no streaks remain.
Spoon into 6 small cups or glasses and chill until set.
Whip the remaining 50ml cream and top each cup with a spoonful and the grated chocolate.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus 2 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 2 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Vegan Chocolate Avocado Mousse Cups
recipes.summary: A rich, smooth mousse made from ripe avocado and coconut cream, with no dairy or eggs.
steps: Scoop the avocado into a blender with the cocoa, maple syrup, coconut cream, vanilla and salt.
Blend for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides, until completely smooth and glossy.
Taste and add a little more maple syrup if wanted.
Spoon into 6 small cups and chill until firm. Top with the grated chocolate.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Plus 1 hour chilling. Check that the chocolate is dairy free.
Storage: keeps 2 days covered in the fridge; the surface may darken slightly.

recipes.title: Lemon Posset Cups
recipes.summary: Three-ingredient set cream cups with a tart lemon flavour.
steps: Heat the cream, sugar and lemon zest in a saucepan, stirring until the sugar dissolves, then boil gently for 3 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice. Strain into a jug.
Pour into 6 small glasses and cool for 15 minutes, then chill until set.
Serve topped with the berries.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus 4 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 3 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Cornflour Vanilla Panna Cotta Cups
recipes.summary: A soft-set vanilla cream dessert thickened with cornflour instead of gelatine, so it is vegetarian.
steps: Whisk the cornflour with 3 tbsp of the milk until smooth.
Heat the cream, remaining milk and sugar until steaming, whisk in the cornflour mixture and stir for 4 minutes until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Stir in the vanilla, pour into 6 glasses and cool for 15 minutes, then chill until set.
Warm the berries with the honey for 2 minutes and spoon over to serve.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus 4 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 3 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Coconut Panna Cotta Cups
recipes.summary: Vegan coconut milk puddings set with cornflour and served with pineapple.
steps: Whisk the cornflour with 4 tbsp of the oat milk until smooth.
Heat the coconut milk, remaining oat milk and sugar until steaming, whisk in the cornflour mixture and stir for 4 minutes until thick.
Stir in the vanilla, pour into 6 glasses, cool for 15 minutes and chill until set.
Toast the coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until pale gold. Top each cup with pineapple and coconut.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Plus 4 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 3 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Berry Trifle Cups
recipes.summary: Layers of sponge, fruit, custard and cream in small glasses.
steps: Toss the sponge with the apple juice and divide between 8 glasses. Warm the berries with the jam for 2 minutes and spoon over the sponge.

Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour. Heat the milk until steaming and whisk into the yolk mixture, then return to the pan and stir over low heat for 5 minutes until thick enough to coat a spoon and reaches 75°C.
Cool the custard for 15 minutes, spoon over the berries and chill until set.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and spoon on top.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus 3 hours chilling.
Storage: assemble up to a day ahead; keep in the fridge.

recipes.title: Marsala Trifle Cups
recipes.summary: Sponge soaked in a Marsala syrup with mascarpone cream and cocoa, a tiramisu-style cup.
steps: Warm the Marsala with the caster sugar and 2 tbsp water for 1 minute until dissolved, then cool.
Beat the mascarpone, cream, icing sugar and vanilla to soft peaks.
Divide half the sponge between 8 small glasses, sprinkle with half the Marsala syrup, and spoon over half the cream.
Repeat the layers, then chill until set.
Dust with the cocoa just before serving.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains alcohol (Marsala is cooked off only slightly). Plus 3 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Baked Vanilla Cheesecake Squares
recipes.summary: A creamy baked cheesecake on a crumbly oat and butter base.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional). Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Mix the oats, melted butter and brown sugar and press firmly into the tin. Bake for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese and caster sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and lemon juice.
Pour over the base and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until set at the edges with a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool in the tin, chill, then cut into 12 squares.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Food safety: bake until the filling is fully set with no liquid centre, reaching 75°C in the middle.
Plus 4 hours chilling before cutting.
Storage: keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Mini Chocolate Cheesecakes
recipes.summary: Single-serve chocolate cheesecakes baked in a muffin tin.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional). Line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases.
Mix the oats, butter and brown sugar and press a spoonful into each case until firmly packed.
Beat the cream cheese and caster sugar until smooth, beat in the eggs, melted chocolate, cocoa and sour cream.
Divide between the cases and bake for 16 to 18 minutes until set at the edges with a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool in the tin, then chill.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Food safety: bake until the filling is fully set with no liquid centre, reaching 75°C in the middle.
Plus 3 hours chilling.
Storage: keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cheesecake Bars
recipes.summary: Spiced pumpkin cheesecake on an oat and pecan base.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional). Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Mix the oats, pecans, butter and brown sugar, press into the tin and bake for 10 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese and caster sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, pumpkin, cinnamon and ginger.
Pour over the base and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until set at the edges with a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool in the tin, chill, then cut into 12 bars.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains nuts. Food safety: bake until the filling is fully set with no liquid centre, reaching 75°C in the middle.
Plus 4 hours chilling.
Storage: keep in the fridge for up to 4 days.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Cheesecake Cups
recipes.summary: A no-bake cheesecake in glasses with mango and coconut, firmed with chilling rather than gelatine.
steps: Mix the oats, butter and honey and press into the base of 6 glasses.
Beat the cream cheese, coconut cream, icing sugar and vanilla until thick and smooth.
Spoon over the bases, smooth the tops and chill until firm.
Top with the mango, and scatter with the coconut just before serving.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Plus 4 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 2 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mini Pavlova Nests
recipes.summary: Crisp-shelled, marshmallow-centred meringue nests with cream and berries.
steps: Heat the oven to 120°C fan (140°C conventional). Line two trays with baking paper.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoonful at a time and whisk for 8 minutes until thick, glossy and no longer gritty when rubbed between fingers.
Fold in the cornflour, vinegar and vanilla. Spoon 12 mounds onto the trays and make a well in the centre of each.
Bake for 70 to 75 minutes until dry and crisp on the outside. Turn off the oven and cool inside with the door ajar.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar, fill the nests and top with the berries just before serving.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Gluten free.
Storage: store unfilled nests in an airtight tin for 3 days; fill just before serving.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pots de Creme
recipes.summary: Baked chocolate custards in small pots, smooth and fudgy.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C fan (170°C conventional). Place six 100ml ramekins in a deep baking dish.
Heat the cream and milk until steaming and pour over the broken chocolate. Stand for 2 minutes, then stir until smooth.
Whisk the yolks, sugar, vanilla and salt, then slowly whisk in the chocolate mixture.
Strain into a jug, pour into the ramekins and pour hot water into the dish to halfway up the sides.
Bake for 28 to 30 minutes until set at the edges with a slight wobble in the middle, then cool and chill.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Food safety: bake until the custard is set with no liquid centre, reaching 75°C in the middle.
Plus 3 hours chilling.
Storage: keeps 3 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Poached Pear Cups
recipes.summary: Pears gently poached in spiced apple juice and served with yoghurt.
steps: Combine the apple juice, cinnamon, honey and lemon zest in a pan and bring to a gentle simmer until the honey dissolves.
Add the pears and poach for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until a knife slides in easily.
Lift out the pears and boil the liquid for 8 minutes until reduced to a syrup.
Slice each pear half and divide between 6 cups with the yoghurt, drizzle with syrup and scatter with the walnuts.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains nuts.
Storage: pears keep 3 days in their syrup in the fridge.

recipes.title: Self-Saucing Chocolate Pudding Cups
recipes.summary: Soft chocolate puddings that make their own sauce as they bake.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C fan (190°C conventional). Grease eight 150ml ramekins.
Whisk the flour, 30g cocoa and caster sugar, then whisk in the milk, butter and egg until smooth.
Divide between the ramekins. Mix the brown sugar and remaining cocoa, sprinkle over the batter, then pour 2 tbsp of the boiling water over each until the sugar is covered.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes until the tops are set and springy.
Stand for 3 minutes and serve with the sauce at the base.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 pudding.
Storage: best eaten straight from the oven.

recipes.title: Steamed Golden Syrup Puddings
recipes.summary: Small steamed sponge puddings with golden syrup running down the sides.
steps: Grease six 150ml pudding moulds and spoon 2 tsp golden syrup into the base of each.
Beat the butter and sugar for 3 minutes until pale. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour, milk and zest.
Divide between the moulds, cover each tightly with foil and place in a deep pan with boiling water to halfway up the sides.
Cover the pan and steam gently for 40 to 45 minutes until risen and a skewer comes out clean, topping up the water if needed.
Turn out and serve with the remaining syrup warmed.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 pudding.
Storage: best eaten warm; reheat for 30 seconds in the microwave.

recipes.title: Orange Cardamom Rice Pudding Cups
recipes.summary: Creamy rice pudding cooked on the hob scented with cardamom and orange, served warm or cold.
steps: Rinse the rice, then combine with the milk, coconut milk, sugar, cardamom and zest in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 30 to 35 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is very soft and the pudding is thick and creamy.
Remove the cardamom pods, spoon into 6 cups and scatter with the pistachios.
Serve warm or chill until cold.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Contains nuts.
Storage: keeps 3 days covered in the fridge; stir in a splash of milk when reheating.
